fullTextEN: Hi, everyone!
I am Sasa.

fullTextZH: 今天我想说一说我的奶奶。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about my grandma.

fullTextZH: 我的奶奶今年已经80多岁了，
fullTextEN: My grandma is already over 80 years old this year,
but if you meet her,

fullTextZH: 你不会相信她是80多岁的人。
fullTextEN: you wouldn't believe she is over 80 years old.
She looks only 50 or 60 years old.
Not only does she look young,

fullTextZH: 她做的事情也很像年轻人。
fullTextEN: but she also does things like a young person.
She likes to buy beautiful clothes,
and wear beautiful dresses.
Sometimes I go to her house,
and wear her clothes out,
and no one thinks it's strange.
Because her clothes

fullTextZH: 都是年轻人会喜欢的那一种。
fullTextEN: are the kind young people like.
She has a lot of cosmetics,
and she puts on makeup every day.
In the morning, she finishes her makeup,
and puts on a beautiful dress,
Put on sunglasses,
go out and take the bus,
go dance with friends.
By the way,
In China, if you are over 60 years old,
you will have a senior card.
When taking the bus,
use the senior card for free,
no cost.

fullTextZH: 每次我的奶奶坐公交的时候，
fullTextEN: Every time my grandma takes the bus,
as soon as she gets on, she swipes the card—
"senior card."
The drivers always take a second look at her,
because they don't believe

fullTextZH: 我的奶奶已经超过60岁了。
fullTextEN: my grandma is already over 60 years old.
In her own mind,
she also feels very young.
She dances the waltz every day.

fullTextZH: 华尔兹就是男人和女人一起跳的舞。
fullTextEN: The waltz is a dance for men and women together.
Once she told us:
"The old man who danced with me,
he is too old,
he is already over 50 years old."

fullTextZH: 但是这个时候我的奶奶已经70多岁了。
fullTextEN: But at that time, my grandmother was already over 70 years old.

fullTextZH: 她觉得50多岁的老头很老。
fullTextEN: She thought that men over 50 were very old.
Many people admired her,
and would also ask her:
"Why are you so young?"

fullTextZH: 她回答说：“我也不知道呀。”
fullTextEN: She replied: "I don't know either."

fullTextZH: 其实她小的时候过得不好。
fullTextEN: Actually, she didn't have a good childhood.
When she was very young,
her mother passed away.

fullTextZH: 她的爸爸给她找了一个后妈。
fullTextEN: Her father found her a stepmother.
The stepmother was very unkind to her.

fullTextZH: 再后来，她的爸爸也生病去世了。
fullTextEN: Later, her father also fell ill and passed away.
The stepmother then ignored her even more.
Fortunately, she had an older sister,
who always took care of her,
and they grew up together.
But my grandmother,
Her mind is very simple,

fullTextZH: 她不会想很多复杂的事情。
fullTextEN: She doesn't think about many complicated things.
So her childhood wasn't good,

fullTextZH: 并没有让她变成一个不开心的人。
fullTextEN: but it didn't make her an unhappy person.

fullTextZH: 简单可能就是她年轻的秘密。
fullTextEN: Simplicity might be her secret to youth.
She is really very simple,
and very cute.
She never went to school,
so she is not very educated,
and often says the wrong things.

fullTextZH: 有时候会把我们都逗笑。
fullTextEN: Sometimes she makes us all laugh.
I remember once,
we watched the news together.
The news said there was a person

fullTextZH: 他“应邀”参加一个重要的会议。
fullTextEN: who was 'invited' to attend an important meeting.
'Invited' means accepting an invitation.
But when my grandma heard it,

fullTextZH: 她突然说：“这个人好奇怪呀！
fullTextEN: she suddenly said, 'This person is so strange!
Others didn't let him attend the meeting,
but he insisted on attending the meeting.'
"Yingyao" means the same as "feiyao".

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈不让我吃冰激凌，
fullTextEN: My mom doesn't let me eat ice cream,
I insist on eating it,
I insist on eating.
Insist,
Insist.

fullTextZH: 我的奶奶不知道什么是“应邀”，
fullTextEN: My grandma doesn't know what "yingyao" is,
She thinks this person:

fullTextZH: 别人不让他来参加会议，
fullTextEN: Others didn't let him attend the meeting,
He insisted on coming,

fullTextZH: 在门口敲门说：“让我进去，
fullTextEN: Knocked on the door at the entrance saying: "Let me in,
I want to attend this meeting!"

fullTextZH: 那天我们全家人都笑了，
fullTextEN: That day our whole family laughed,
We laughed for a long time.
She is so cute!
She is very simple,
and also very easy to trust others,
so she often gets deceived.
When she was young,

fullTextZH: 有一次有一个人看到她，
fullTextEN: Once someone saw her,
Said to her:
"My leg is injured,
I can't walk,
I also can't go to work.
I have no money now,

fullTextZH: 我很饿，你可以帮帮我吗？”
fullTextEN: I'm very hungry, can you help me?"

fullTextZH: 我的奶奶马上拿出很多钱给他，
fullTextEN: My grandmother immediately took out a lot of money for him,
letting him go eat.
The person was very happy to get the money,
and quickly ran away.
His leg was not injured at all.
My grandmother was a little angry:
"She tricked me!"

fullTextZH: 最近我奶奶也说她好像被骗了，
fullTextEN: Recently my grandmother also said she seemed to have been tricked,
she was very scared.

fullTextZH: 因为在网上有很多人认识她。
fullTextEN: Because many people know her online.
She said on Douyin—
which is China's TikTok—
when she watches videos,
someone said: "You—
Yes,
It's you looking at the phone—
I know you,
I have something to tell you.
My grandma is very scared,

fullTextZH: 她相信这个人真的可以看到她，
fullTextEN: She believes this person can really see her,

fullTextZH: 她相信这个人真的认识她。
fullTextEN: She believes this person really knows her.
So she doesn't dare to look at the phone anymore.

fullTextZH: 真的太容易相信别人了！
fullTextEN: It's really too easy to trust others!
Her happiness is simple:
She can buy a new piece of clothing,
Turn around in front of the mirror,
Turn back and look at herself,
"I'm very beautiful,"
She will be very happy.
Her anger is also simple:
She doesn't like cooking.

fullTextZH: 如果家里来了很多客人，
fullTextEN: If many guests come to the house,
She might say:
"Why are there so many people?
I don't want to cook!
Don't come next time.
She does whatever she wants to do,

fullTextZH: 不在乎别人喜不喜欢她。
fullTextEN: She doesn't care if others like her or not.
The most important thing for her every day
is to be happy herself.
And me—

fullTextZH: 她希望她的孙女过得开心，
fullTextEN: She hopes her granddaughter is happy,
because she loves me very much.
I really admire my grandmother.

fullTextZH: 不是因为她看起来很年轻，
fullTextEN: Not because she looks very young,

fullTextZH: 而是因为她有一颗简单的心。
fullTextEN: but because she has a simple heart.
What about you?
What is your grandmother like?
Is your relationship with her good?
Do you also want to stay young?
If you also want to stay young,
you can learn from my grandmother:
Live simply and happily every day.
This is my grandmother's story.
I hope you can like it.
See you next time!
Goodbye.
